lines.text: Two notes meet in the hall. One is gone in a single tick. The other waits, and waits, for two.
That slow one is called a minim
A true story from music history.
Seven hundred years ago, the minim really was one of the shortest notes around. Its name comes from the Latin minima, the smallest.
Over the centuries, composers kept inventing shorter and shorter notes, and the old ones slowly grew longer. The name stayed put. Now the minim is one of the long ones.
A crotchet is one tick. A minim waits for two.
